items.title: Israeli strike on Gaza hospital kills at least six, including doctor and child, Palestinian officials say
items.brief: An Israeli strike on a hospital in southern Gaza overnight Wednesday killed at least six people, including a doctor and a child, Palestinian officials say.

items.title: A ‘clear recommendation’ for men: Get screened for prostate cancer
items.brief: One of the leading cancer organizations in the United States is raising the alarm over prostate cancer and directly urging men to get screened.

items.title: Manchester United fires Michael Carrick as head coach, lines up US coach Mauricio Pochettino
items.brief: Manchester United has fired embattled head coach Michael Carrick after a dire start to the season that leaves the once-great club languishing in the Premier League relegation zone.

items.title: She survived the 9/11 attacks but died two months later in a plane crash. 25 years later, her family is telling her story

items.title: Republicans’ lame-duck dash to confirm judges is already hitting speed bumps
items.brief: The Democrats’ coming takeover of the Senate has kickstarted a scramble to confirm two dozen of President Donald Trump’s judicial nominees before Republicans turn over the gavel in January.

items.title: Russian ambassador to US dies suddenly after suffering chronic illness, foreign ministry says
items.brief: Russia’s ambassador to the United States, Alexander Darchiev, died in Moscow aged 66, after struggling with a chronic illness, the Russian Foreign Ministry said on Wednesday.
